HaileyJohnson invites LiHua to taste a new bread recipe that Hailey has been working on. The conversation indicates that the bread will be fresh out of the oven at the time of tasting, which is scheduled for 3 PM. LiHua is enthusiastic about the opportunity, expressing excitement to taste what Hailey has created and offering additional feedback for improvement.

```markdown
HaileyJohnson: Hey! I’ve been trying out a new bread recipe and would love for you to taste it. Are you free to come by the bakery? 🥖💛
LiHua: Sounds awesome! I’d love to help out. What time is good for you? 😊
HaileyJohnson: How about 3 PM? It’ll be fresh out of the oven! Let me know if that works for you. 🕒✨
LiHua: That works perfectly! Can't wait to taste what you've made. See you at 3! 🍞😋
HaileyJohnson: Yay! Looking forward to it! I have a feeling you’re going to love it. See you soon! 🥳
```

In summary, HaileyJohnson wants LiHua to come to the bakery at 3 PM to taste a freshly baked new bread recipe that Hailey has developed. This visit is particularly significant as Hailey values LiHua's feedback to enhance the recipe further.
